candidate_workaround: Use rg --files to enumerate matching files and pass exact paths to the content search.
failure_signature: Ripgrep receives a PowerShell-style wildcard path on Windows and rejects it as an invalid filename.
recurrence_guard: Never pass an unexpanded Windows wildcard as an rg path argument; enumerate then search exact paths.
rollback: Retain partial read-only output and rerun only the failed search surface; mutate no repository state.
scope_boundary: Workflow evidence only; no scientific, security, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Exact-path ripgrep recovery for Windows wildcard faults
trigger_preconditions: A Windows stale-label or content search spans generated filenames selected by a wildcard.
